The ideal candidate is able to juggle multiple partners at once and has existing partner relationships that they can bring to Nerdio. Negotiate pricing for Nerdio solutions in accordance with the company’s pricing policies and procedures. Competency and understanding of VDI cloud technologies and operating models Familiarity with AVD, Citrix, or VMware VDI and relevant virtual desktop cloud technologies and solutions. Exceptional presentation and verbal communication skills, strong presence. Be the opportunity detective.
